claims.text: Idempotency (failure-modes): the same TrueLayer file imported twice leaves the case unchanged (R39), and a page repeat is kept once while a repeated id with different content is refused naming both lines.
claims.proof_cmd: python -m pytest tests/test_import_truelayer.py -q -k 'keeps_the_golden_statement_and_the_hints_apart or repeated_id or golden'

claims.text: Partial failure leaves a repairable state (failure-modes): an import the case log refuses puts back every file, hints included; a leftover hints file from an import whose entry never landed is removed by the next import into that account.
External calls/timeouts/retries (failure-modes): not applicable. The importer reads a local file and makes no network call; nothing is retried.

Data/PII (data): the provider's categories live only in statements/<account>.hints.json under the owner-only case root (0o600). They are kept as untrusted hints and read onto Transaction.provider_hint. No figure, rule, indicator, evidence record, MCP output or prompt reads them.
claims.proof_cmd: python -m pytest tests/test_import_truelayer.py -q -k 'owner_only or unchanged_when_the_hints_change or cannot_be_read'; grep -rn --include=*.py provider_hint src
claims.proof_output: 6 passed; provider_hint appears only at src/cma/models.py:95 (field), src/cma/overrides.py:245 (set from hints), src/cma/importers/truelayer.py:28 (docstring)

claims.text: Migration (data): additive. There is a new optional hints file and a new format value. No stored format changes, and v1 and the existing importers are untouched (full suite green).

Input validation and no secrets (security): every field is validated at the boundary. A refusal names lines, never cell values (sentinel check), and an id that a spreadsheet reads as a formula is refused. No dependency was added and no secret is in code or fixtures.
claims.proof_cmd: python -m pytest tests/test_import_truelayer.py -q -k 'malformed or not_a_truelayer or not_in_gbp or names_the_file_not_its_cells'; git diff aa0f91a..HEAD --stat -- pyproject.toml

claims.text: Authz on the new entry point (security): `--format truelayer` goes through the same store.import_file as the other formats: same case root permissions, case lock and log entry. It adds no new access path.

claims.text: Performance: single pass over the records; line numbers come from a bisect over newline offsets; each hint is capped at 200 characters. There are no queries or list endpoints, so that part of the checklist does not apply.
Tests are marked for the runner (gotcha): every new test is @pytest.mark.contracts, and the contracts tier passes. Lint and compile are clean.

notes: Gaps for the owner: (1) Observability: the case log entry records format, pending and repeated counts and hints_sha256, but no `cma report` signal counts hints. Adding one is new design, so it was not built. (2) Operability: rollback is CMA_RULESET or a reinstall; I did not run either outside pytest. An older package ignores the hints file. (3) Docs: there is no changelog file in the repo to add a line to. (4) Security, for later: hints are stripped of control characters and capped at 200 characters but not escaped. Nothing renders them today. Whoever first shows provider_hint in the workspace or record.html must escape it (R34).
